description:
Production-connected boundary T4b. After the recorded observation disposition and explicit owner activation approval, add only the named Theseus gateway client and perform the first genuine Theseus hosted review under its separate App. Record the measurement epoch boundary before any shared clients.json regeneration, agent restart, live review or gateway change. Use a quiet-time procedure and preserve BenchBox clients/OMP cache and in-flight reviews. Prove the gate source is the configured Theseus App, then owner enforces the required check; owner full-diff bootstrap governance ends only once that check is actually enforced.
Guardrails: no natural-event observation can be manufactured as proof of old observation acceptance. These live reviews are explicitly extraction verification, tagged to the new epoch. No unapproved restart, shared-account load, App reuse, settings write, secret disclosure, bypass or production publication.
